videos.desc: An indoor climbing gym with tall walls covered in colourful holds and thick blue mats on the floor. A young woman with long braids, in a mint crop top and black leggings, pushes off from below and climbs up the wall. A young woman with a dark ponytail, in a coral sports top and black leggings, crouches under her, rises and pushes her up from below with her hands, then stands watching and claps chalk off her hands. A chalk bag sits on the mat and other climbers stand in the background.

At the foot of a tall pale limestone cliff with orange streaks, under a deep blue sky, a young man in a blue T-shirt and climbing harness kneels on a red mat and checks the knot where an orange rope is tied into the harness of a young woman. She wears a green sports top, black leggings and a harness hung with metal clips, smiles down at him with her hands together, then rubs her hands and gets ready to climb. A coil of rope, a water bottle, shoes and spiky agave plants lie around them.

In a boxing gym with a dark metal roof and hanging lamps, a young woman with two braids, in a coral sports top and black leggings, stands in the corner of a blue ring with red boxing gloves raised. A young woman in a white t-shirt and a young man in a black vest rest a hand on her shoulders from outside the ropes. She then walks forward into the ring with a focused face, while the young man stays behind the ropes, smiling. A padded corner post, a towel and a water bottle are by the ropes.

On an outdoor sports court with high green walls, a fence and old stone arches, a young woman with a long braid, in a rust sports top, films herself up close, grinning widely, and then points her thumb back over her shoulder. Behind her a young woman in a black sports top and grey shorts holds a huge rough boulder on her shoulder with both hands, straining under its weight. Wooden benches with towels stand under the arches, and a straw mat lies on the ground.

On a rocky mountain summit at sunrise, high above a sea of clouds, a young woman in a coral sports top and black leggings sits barefoot on the rock and raises both fists in triumph, while a young man in a navy vest and beige shorts lies back on the rock laughing with his arms spread. She lowers her arms, smiles at him and then lies back on the rock too. Hiking boots, socks, a water bottle, trekking poles and backpacks lie in front, and a wild goat stands on the rocks to the right.

On a misty cliff top at sunrise, a young woman in a climbing harness, a grey jacket, khaki trousers and black boots walks across a narrow wooden plank bridge hung on cables over a deep drop, holding a guide rope with one hand. She laughs, looks back once and keeps stepping forward from plank to plank toward the rock. A group of young people on a rocky ledge behind her watch, some crouching with ropes. Coiled ropes and metal anchor bolts lie on the rock in the foreground.

On a mountain road in autumn, a young woman in a green cycling jersey and white helmet rides a road bike uphill and smiles, while a young man in a white T-shirt and black shorts runs beside her on the grassy verge, pumping his fist in the air and shouting encouragement. Two women at the roadside clap and cheer, and a car waits behind them. Bright yellow aspen trees, a stone wall, fallen leaves and snowy peaks under grey clouds surround the road.

On a wide, flat, white salt plain at sunrise under a pale pink sky, a young man in a white sleeveless top, navy trousers and white socks pushes up into a perfectly straight handstand on a simple wooden set of two parallel bars, his arms locked and his legs pointing to the sky. Then he swings off the bars sideways, lands on the cracked salt ground in a cloud of white dust and throws both arms up in triumph.

On a mountain road in bright summer sunshine, a young woman in a teal cycling jersey with a long braid and a white helmet rides towards the camera, smiling. As the view widens, two men in helmets appear riding level with her, one in grey with mirrored glasses and one in yellow, and the three ride side by side round a bend while the woman smiles across at the others. A low stone wall runs along the edge of the road, with high rocky peaks behind them under a pale blue sky.

In a climbing centre built inside an old empty indoor swimming pool with a glass roof and big arched windows, a young woman with a long braid hangs from coloured holds on a steep overhanging wall high above the tiled pool. She swings, reaches up, kicks her legs and hooks one leg back up, while chalk dust puffs in the air and a rope hangs below her. Down in the dry pool people climb the tiled walls over thick blue and red mats, a metal pool ladder remains on the side, and a small cafe counter stands at the back.

In a desert with Joshua trees and round granite boulders at sunset, a young woman climber with a messy bun, a rust-coloured tank top, olive trousers and climbing shoes crouches on top of a rock under a huge overhanging boulder. She reaches up and touches the rock with a chalky finger, then brings her hand to her chin and studies it carefully. Finally she rubs her hands together and a small puff of chalk dust floats in the low sunlight.

A young woman climber in a red down jacket with the hood up, ski goggles, black trousers, a harness with an ice axe and yellow boots with crampons steps onto the narrow snowy summit of a mountain on a clear day, her arms spread for balance. Far below lies a sea of white clouds with rocky peaks poking through. She stands still on the top, lifts her goggles onto her head, laughs and waves. A rope runs down behind her and her shadow falls across the snow.

A young woman with a long braid, a red helmet, a red vest top, black shorts and hiking boots abseils down the wet cliff face of a deep, narrow rock canyon, with ferns on the walls and a waterfall pouring down in a misty beam of light behind. She sits back in her harness with her feet against the rock and holds the rope with gloved hands as she moves lower step by step. As she goes down, a pool of water with round stones comes into view at the bottom of the canyon.

On a cobbled lane at a street festival at sunset, a young woman in a teal and bronze superhero costume, a visor and tall boots holds up a long metal beam above her head with both hands. She rises from a wide squat until she stands straight with her legs apart, keeping the beam up under a lit metal arch. Behind her a crowd of young people with drinks and food watch and cheer, one man raising his fist, under strings of bulbs over the stalls. A paper lantern and torn red and white bunting lie on the cobbles in front of her.

A sparring match in a dim boxing gym strung with fairy lights. A young woman with two long braids, in a black sports top and black shorts, throws a straight punch with her left hand in a gold boxing glove at a young man in black wearing headgear, while her right hand stays up by her chin as a guard. She pulls back, throws another left and then smiles behind her gloves. A crowd of people stands behind the ropes watching, and heavy punch bags hang under the lamps in the background.

On a high mountain pass in a snowstorm, a man in a black cycling helmet and black kit rides a racing bike up a snow-covered road towards the front, his face set and his breath steaming, snowflakes stuck to his clothes. He keeps pedalling hard and comes closer. Behind him a group of cyclists wrapped in silver foil blankets stand outside a small stone hut and watch, and a marmot sits on a rock by the road. Dark clouds and rays of light cover the snowy peaks behind.

Inside an indoor climbing hall, a young woman in a green top and black shorts leaps off the wall with one arm stretched up and grabs the big yellow hold at the very top of the steep grey climbing wall, chalk dust puffing from her hand. She hangs from it with her legs swinging. On the blue padded floor below, three friends in sports clothes watch, then throw their arms up and cheer. More climbers stand near a counter, and colourful holds cover the walls under a high roof.

An outdoor swimming pool on a hot day. In front, a young woman in sunglasses and a coral bikini lies relaxed on a big pink doughnut-shaped float with a drink in her hand, waves and then settles back without moving from her spot. Behind her, a young man jumps from the top of a tall white diving tower with his arms and legs spread, another person dives head first and splashes into the water, and a man climbs the ladder. Striped beach huts and people sunbathing line the pool.

A concrete gym. A young woman in a coral sports top sits in a round metal tub full of icy water, screaming and laughing as a blonde woman in black gym clothes pours a whole bucket of ice cubes over her head. Ice splashes out onto the black rubber floor. The blonde woman lowers the empty bucket and leans over the tub laughing, while the young woman in the tub grips its edge and shivers. On the right a young man sits laughing with ice packs strapped to his knees, and people train behind.

A narrow snowy mountain ridge high above a sea of clouds in cold morning light. A young woman in a blue down jacket, black trousers, frosted goggles and a woolly hat climbs steadily up the slope towards the viewer, holding a fixed rope with her gloved hand, her crampons biting into the snow and her face tired but determined. Behind her a man in a yellow beanie and a dark jacket follows on the same rope with his head down. The sun glows low behind the clouds.

An industrial gym with brick walls, hanging lamps and punching bags. A young man in a navy vest and black shorts stands facing the viewer, lifting a heavy dumbbell in one hand while he holds a chocolate doughnut in the other. He keeps curling the dumbbell but stares at the doughnut with a doubtful, unsure face, as if weighing up the two. Behind him a young woman in a sports top and a young man in a white T-shirt train and move around.

An industrial gym with brick walls, steel beams and big windows. A young man in a white vest and black shorts stands in front of a tall mirror, raises his arms and flexes both biceps, and his reflection shows him smiling broadly at himself with his chest out. A barbell with black plates lies on the floor behind him. A young woman in a black top and blue shorts smiles and claps beside him, and another man exercises in the background.

A weigh-in at a boxing gym with brick walls, punching bags and a ring. A young woman boxer with braided hair, in a black top, red satin shorts and hand wraps, stands barefoot on a tall metal weighing scale on a raised platform, flexing both arms. A man in a white shirt and black trousers slides the small weight along the scale's beam to measure her, then turns and bumps fists with her. A crowd of young people in winter jackets cheers behind them.

A riverside path on an autumn day, with yellow trees, a stone bridge and boats on the water. A young woman in a lilac top crouches and pulls hard on a lead, but her chubby bulldog sits almost still on the path. Behind them a young woman in a coral top and two young men run towards the camera and race past close by, and a cyclist rides away along the path. The young woman laughs while the bulldog stays where it is. Dry leaves lie on the path.

Seen from a racing bike speeding down a mountain road, the rider's hands in blue gloves grip the drop handlebars. The road and the dry stone wall on the left blur with speed. Ahead a cyclist in a green jersey, black shorts and a helmet races downhill and leans into the bends, her shadow beside her. The road curves on past green meadows with cows, a wooden hut, a waterfall and snowy peaks under a blue sky.
